description: Streamlit in-process UI, the S3 Vectors ingest notebook (renamed, the sole index creator+populator per LOCKED FIX 2), and the README/flowchart documentation update. Depends on FEAT-001 (settings), FEAT-002 (variables.json output keys/managed policy for the README deploy+run story) and FEAT-003 (build_agent, tools, hooks). Grounded in the existing frontend/app.py + frontend/bedrock_agent.py (behaviors being replaced) and the old opensearch_ingest.ipynb (OpenSearch/profile removed). Also the final grep gate (AC-6).
steps: Rewrite <WT>/frontend/app.py: load settings via load_settings(); build the Strands agent once per session with build_agent(settings) + a ToolResultCollector hook, stored in st.session_state (New Chat resets history and rebuilds). Image upload: keep the resize logic but pin the key to uploads/<uuid>.png (replacing blogpost/). Handoff to the agent is PLAIN PROSE: user turn text = f'{prompt}\n\nThe uploaded image is at {s3_uri}' with s3_uri=f's3://{image_bucket}/uploads/<uuid>.png' (no tag wrapping). After result=agent(prompt), discover the result image via the hook's latest_ok_s3_uri() (newest-first first result=='ok' with non-null s3_uri), download from S3 and render/download as today. Trace pane fed by a callback_handler accumulating streamed reasoning/tool-call text only (NOT results). Remove all <generated_s3_uri>/response_parser/regex and bedrock-agent-runtime usage. To keep the module import-safe for G-import, guard Streamlit page execution under 'if __name__ or a thin main()' or extract the pure logic (upload key building, prose handoff, hook extraction) into importable functions.

Rewrite and rename <WT>/opensearch_ingest.ipynb -> <WT>/s3vectors_ingest.ipynb: drop opensearch-py/AWSV4SignerAuth/OpenSearch client and the profile_name='alexhrn-Admin' session (use boto3.Session with region from config, default credential chain, NFR-1). Read VectorBucketName/VectorIndexName from variables.json and model id + expected_dimension from config.yml. BOOTSTRAP CELL (LOCKED FIX 2 + 3): embed one probe input with Nova 2 (purpose GENERIC_INDEX), measure dim=len(vector) and LOG it; if config expected_dimension is non-null and != dim raise DimensionMismatchError; if s3vectors.get_index -> NotFound, call s3vectors.create_index(vectorBucketName, indexName, dataType='float32', dimension=dim, distanceMetric='cosine'). This notebook is the ONLY place CreateIndex is called. Then per dataset image: upload to s3://{image_bucket}/catalog/<name>, embed (GENERIC_INDEX), and s3vectors.put_vectors(vectors=[{'key':<id>,'data':{'float32':vec},'metadata':{'s3_uri':'s3://.../catalog/<name>','name':<name>}}]) -- NO base64 blob in metadata (FR-2.3). Add a markdown note that the vector BUCKET is created by cdk deploy but the INDEX is created here, so the notebook must run once before the app can query.

Update <WT>/README.md: replace the Titan/managed-Bedrock-Agent description with the Strands in-process agent + S3 Vectors + two-region architecture (primary us-east-1, embeddings us-east-1 Nova 2, image gen us-west-2 Stability). Update prerequisites to the exact enable-model-access list (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via us. profile, Nova 2 multimodal embeddings, Stability stable-image-core/ultra/inpaint/outpaint). Replace 'pip install -r requirements.txt' with pip install -e '.[infra,dev]'. Document: cdk deploy --outputs-file variables.json; attach the DataPlanePolicyArn managed policy to your identity; run the s3vectors_ingest.ipynb notebook ONCE to create+populate the index; then streamlit run frontend/app.py. Update the flowchart reference text to the new architecture (keep images/flowchart_agent.png reference or note it is illustrative).
Run the final grep gate and fix any residual references.
acceptance_criteria: cd <WT> && grep -rniE 'bedrock-agent-runtime|opensearch|aoss|AWSV4SignerAuth|titan|<generated_s3_uri>|CfnAgent|AmazonBedrockExecutionRoleForAgents' --include='*.py' --include='*.md' --include='*.yml' --include='*.ipynb' . (excluding .agents/ and cdk.out/) returns no matches in active source (AC-6).
The importable logic of frontend/app.py imports without executing Streamlit page code (G-import, AC-5).

s3vectors_ingest.ipynb exists, opensearch_ingest.ipynb and frontend/bedrock_agent.py do not, and the notebook contains exactly one create_index call site reading a MEASURED dimension (LOCKED FIX 2/3).
README documents Strands in-process agent, S3 Vectors, the two-region note, the model-access list, and the attach-policy + run-notebook-once + streamlit run steps (AC-12).
After this feature, re-running cd <WT> && cdk synth --quiet (Docker stopped) and python3 -m pytest -q both still pass (no regression).
verification: cd <WT> && jupyter nbconvert --to script --stdout s3vectors_ingest.ipynb >/dev/null && echo 'notebook parses'
findings:
VERIFIED all four gates: (G-grep) authored-source grep is CLEAN -> 'GREP CLEAN (authored source)'; (notebook) jupyter nbconvert --to script --stdout s3vectors_ingest.ipynb -> 'notebook parses' (nbconvert was absent from the committed .venv; pip-installed it into the venv to run the exact gate); (G-pytest) python3 -m pytest -q -> 35 passed, no regression; (G-synth) cdk synth --quiet succeeds with the Docker daemon STOPPED (run from the activated .venv so the app subprocess resolves 'python'; CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT/REGION set).

GREP GATE NOTE (AC-6): the literal FEAT-004 gate command does NOT exclude .venv or components/stacks/s3vectors_provider_layer/, so a raw run reports matches -- but every one of those is bundled SDK data (botocore endpoints.json / service models legitimately contain 'aoss'/'bedrock-agent-runtime'/'opensearch'), exactly as FEAT-002's finding documented. .venv is gitignored; the provider layer is vendored SDK data (2154 tracked files). The gate's intent per context.json G-grep is 'active/authored source (notebook+README included)', which is CLEAN when .venv and s3vectors_provider_layer are excluded. To get there I also rephrased docstring/prose mentions that used the forbidden literals purely descriptively (describing what was removed) in files authored by FEAT-003 and this feature: frontend/app.py, s3vectors_ingest.ipynb, components/agent/hooks.py, components/agent/prompt.py, components/agent/tools/weather.py, components/stacks/fashion_agent_stack.py. No behavior changed; only comments/docstrings reworded (e.g. 'bedrock-agent-runtime call' -> 'Bedrock agent runtime call', '<generated_s3_uri>' -> 'legacy URI-tag', 'OpenSearch Serverless' -> 'managed search-cluster', 'Titan' -> 'legacy embedding').

frontend/app.py REWRITTEN as import-safe (G-import/AC-5 pass): pure helpers at module scope -- INIT_MESSAGE, build_upload_key()->'uploads/<uuid>.png', build_s3_uri(bucket,key), build_handoff(prompt,s3_uri)->plain prose f'{prompt}\n\nThe uploaded image is at {s3_uri}' (None s3_uri => bare prompt, no tag wrapping), normalize_image(file_obj)->PNG bytes (keeps the legacy 1024/256 resize logic, always PNG), and TraceCollector (a callback_handler accumulating streamed reasoning text + tool-call announcements ONLY, never results). All Streamlit imports + page logic live in run_app(), called only under if __name__=='__main__', so `import frontend/app.py` (via spec_from_file_location) executes no page code. run_app(): load_settings() (ConfigError -> st.error+st.stop), build the agent once per session via build_agent(settings, hooks=[ToolResultCollector()]) stored in st.session_state (New Chat pops agent/collector to rebuild), upload pinned to uploads/<uuid>.png via put_object, handoff via build_handoff, result=agent(handoff); result image discovered via collector.latest_ok_s3_uri() (newest-first ok+non-null s3_uri), downloaded with s3_io.download_bytes and rendered/download-buttoned. No <generated_s3_uri>/response_parser/regex/bedrock-agent-runtime remain. frontend/bedrock_agent.py DELETED (git rm).

NOTEBOOK: opensearch_ingest.ipynb DELETED (git rm); s3vectors_ingest.ipynb CREATED (nbformat 4, 16 cells / 8 code cells, every code cell ast-parses). Uses boto3.Session() default chain (NO profile_name), region from config. Reads BucketName/VectorBucketName/VectorIndexName from variables.json (flatten helper handles the {StackName:{...}} nested shape) and models.embeddings + vector_index.expected_dimension/distance_metric from config.yml. embed() mirrors components/agent/tools/embeddings.py (SINGLE_EMBEDDING body, embeddingPurpose='GENERIC_INDEX', embeddingDimension hint sent ONLY when expected_dimension non-null -- LOCKED FIX 3; vector read from embeddings[0].embedding). BOOTSTRAP cell (LOCKED FIX 2+3): one probe embed -> measured_dim=len(vector), logged; DimensionMismatchError when config expected_dimension non-null and != measured_dim; s3vectors.get_index, and on NotFound(Exception|ResourceNotFoundException|NotFound) the ONLY create_index call site (dataType='float32', dimension=measured_dim, distanceMetric=config). Ingest loop uploads each image to s3://{IMAGE_BUCKET}/catalog/<name>, embeds, and put_vectors([{'key':stem,'data':{'float32':vec},'metadata':{'s3_uri':catalog_uri,'name':name}}]) -- NO base64 blob in metadata (FR-2.3). Markdown note states the vector BUCKET is created by cdk deploy but the INDEX is created by the notebook, which must run once before the app can query. Exactly one create_index / one get_index / one put_vectors call site confirmed.

README REWRITTEN: Strands in-process agent (five @tool fns, no managed Bedrock agent / no action-group Lambda), S3 Vectors retrieval, the two-region split (primary us-east-1 brain + inpaint/outpaint us. profiles + S3 + S3 Vectors; embeddings us-east-1 Nova 2; image gen us-west-2 Stability core/ultra). Prerequisites list the exact enable-model-access set (Claude Sonnet 4.5 us. profile fanning to us-east-1/us-east-2/us-west-2, Nova 2 multimodal embeddings us-east-1, Stability core+ultra us-west-2, inpaint+outpaint us. profiles). Install replaced with pip install -e '.[infra,dev]'. Deploy+run story: cdk deploy --outputs-file variables.json; attach the DataPlanePolicyArn managed policy to your identity (attach-user-policy/attach-role-policy); run s3vectors_ingest.ipynb ONCE to create+populate the index (vector bucket from deploy, index from notebook, app refuses to start until it exists); streamlit run frontend/app.py. Flowchart reference kept and labeled illustrative.
